svg.title: Where each primitive can be enforced
svg.desc: Four enforcement layers from the shallowest (context) to the deepest (governance), with the primitives each can carry. Ten of the twenty-nine can be carried in context; the floor never can.
svg.text: A prompt is the shallowest layer: where each primitive can be enforced
10 of 29 primitives can be carried in context. The rest need code, architecture or people. A primitive may appear in more than one layer; this placement is
the model applies the rule in its own
records, screens and parsers the model's
A prohibition written into a prompt is a trained refusal, and the right prompt can talk it round. E1 requires forbidden actions to be
unavailable: remove the credential, not just the wish. compasskit audit reports AUD-002 when the floor lives only in context.
Class A: a team may adopt it alone
Class B: a named person ratifies it, with a falsifier and a review date
